{{Top|leg}}
The '''Loronar shipyards''' was a shipyard complex at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Loronar/Legends|Loronar]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the Cold War, a [[Unidentified beetle|strange variety of beetle]] that could feed on [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] radiation infested the shipyards.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Hyperdrive Nests}}</ref>
